faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common Questions About Our Services
faq.q1: What types of engines do you import?
faq.a1: We import various types of engines including petrol, diesel, and hybrid engines from reputable European sources including France, Belgium, Germany, Italy, and Spain.
faq.a2: Yes, we provide professional engine installation services at our mechanical workshop. Our experienced technicians ensure proper installation and testing.
faq.a3: We offer warranty coverage on our engines and parts. The warranty terms vary depending on the type of part. Contact us for specific warranty details for your purchase.
faq.a4: Shipping times vary depending on the source country and availability. Typically, orders from Europe take 2-4 weeks. We provide estimated delivery times for each order.
faq.q5: Do you ship to other countries?
faq.a5: Yes, we serve multiple countries including Tunisia, Algeria, Morocco, and others. Contact us to check if we ship to your location.
faq.q6: How can I track my order?
faq.a6: Once your order is shipped, we provide you with tracking information so you can monitor your shipment's progress.
faq.q7: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a7: We accept various payment methods including bank transfers, cash, and mobile payment options. Contact us for more details.
faq.a8: Yes, our knowledgeable team is available to provide technical support and answer any questions you may have about our products and services.
